title: Point of Sale & Inventory
shortDesc: Cashier & admin interface with inventory, pricing, and reports.
longDesc:
Cashier & admin interface with inventory, pricing, and reports. Built with Java 16, UCanAccess, and Microsoft Access.

Features:
• Cashier mode: fast checkout with barcode support
• Admin dashboard: inventory overview
• Product management (add, update, delete)
• Real-time stock tracking
• Sales reports and analytics
• User account creation for staff
• Low stock alerts
